project_info.name: JiveAI Intake Agent
project_info.description: AI-powered field service intake agent with multi-channel processing

job_enrichment.system_prompt: You are an AI assistant specialized in field service job analysis. Your task is to analyze unstructured job requests and extract structured information including service type, urgency level, issue classification, and potential parts needed.
job_enrichment.user_prompt_template:
Analyze this field service request and provide structured data:

Customer: {customer_name}
Description: {description}
Address: {address}

Please categorize this job and provide:
1. Service type (AC Repair, Install, Maintenance, Heating, Other)
2. Urgency level (low, medium, high)
3. Issue type classification
4. Potential parts that might be needed
5. Professional summary of the issue
6. Confidence score (0-100)

voice_transcription_analysis.system_prompt: You are analyzing voice transcriptions from field service customers. Extract key information and classify the service request based on the transcribed text.
voice_transcription_analysis.user_prompt_template:
Analyze this voice transcription from a customer service call:

Transcription: {transcription_text}
Caller: {phone_number}

Extract:
1. Customer issue description
2. Service type needed
3. Urgency level
4. Any specific equipment mentioned
5. Preferred timing if mentioned

sms_processing.system_prompt: You are processing SMS messages for field service intake. Parse the message content to extract service request information.

sms_confirmations.job_created_success: Thank you! Your service request has been received as job #{job_id}. We'll contact you within 24 hours to schedule your {service_type} service.
sms_confirmations.job_created_urgent: URGENT REQUEST RECEIVED: Job #{job_id} has been prioritized. Our team will contact you within 2 hours for your {service_type} service.
sms_confirmations.job_created_standard: Service request received as job #{job_id}. Expected contact time: 4-6 hours for {service_type} service.

voice_twiml.welcome_message:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Response>
  <Say voice="alice">Thank you for calling JiveAI Intake Agent. Please leave a detailed message about your service request after the beep, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.</Say>
  <Record action="/api/twilio/webhook/recording" method="POST" maxLength="300" finishOnKey="#" transcribe="true" transcribeCallback="/api/twilio/webhook/transcription" />
  <Say voice="alice">Thank you for your message. Goodbye.</Say>
</Response>
voice_twiml.recording_confirmation:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Response>
  <Say voice="alice">Your message has been recorded as job number {job_id}. Thank you!</Say>
</Response>
voice_twiml.error_response:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<Response>
  <Say voice="alice">We're experiencing technical difficulties. Please try calling again later.</Say>
</Response>
